description: Use this when the user wants to edit their resume in an editor, apply a template, or download it as a PDF or Word file. Make a link that opens this resume in ATSPrep Studio, the free editor, so the user can fix it, pick a template and download a PDF. The text travels in the link's #fragment, which is never sent to a server.

resume_text.description: The whole resume as plain text, one heading, role or bullet per line.
